code_monster.louse: Bite's damage is rolled once per louse, 5–7, at the start of the fight, and it starts with 3–7 Curl Up; no move three times in a row.
code_monster.lagavulin: Asleep for 3 turns; the third wakes it and takes 8 off its Metallicize. HP damage wakes it early, stunned for a turn, with the same 8 off. Then Attack, Attack, Siphon Soul, repeating.
code_monster.hexaghost: Activate, then Divider: 6 hits of your HP / 12 + 1, fixed when it is chosen; then Sear, Tackle, Sear, Inflame, Tackle, Sear, Inferno, repeating. The first Inferno upgrades every Burn, and from then on Sear adds Burn+.
code_monster.guardian: Offensive mode cycles Charging Up, Fierce Bash, Vent Steam, Whirlwind. Losing its Mode Shift HP switches it to Defensive mode: 20 block and Close Up, then Roll Attack, then Twin Slam, which returns it to Offensive mode with Whirlwind next. Mode Shift comes back at 30, +10 per switch.
